scenario: The morning after the storm, Bandarban is washed clean. The air is fresh with the smell of wet earth and jungle blossoms. The tension from last night seems to have been swept away with the rain.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: At breakfast, Mr. Irfan seems more relaxed. He mentions the land dispute is more complicated than he let on, involving old family promises and local legends.

outcomes.flavor: Despite the intrigue, your situation remains unaffected.

scenario: Fakhruddin is scanning the distant hills with his binoculars. He mutters that he saw a flicker of light, like sunlight reflecting off glass, from a ridge overlooking the bungalow.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: Nasir bhai is talking with Karim chacha, the caretaker. He later tells you Karim chacha's family has lived in this valley for generations, long before any bungalows were built.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: Oli is ecstatic. The post-storm weather is perfect for flying his drone. He's planning a full aerial survey of the property, especially the dense jungle behind the bungalow.

outcomes.flavor: Despite the intrigue, your situation remains unaffected.

scenario: Ahsanul Mama is reading a book on local tribal history from the bungalow's library. He remarks that the Chakma people have a deep spiritual connection to this land.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: You overhear Mr. Irfan on the phone, his voice tense. He mentions a 'deal going sour' and 'unexpected complications' that have nothing to do with a land dispute.

outcomes.flavor: Despite the intrigue, your situation remains unaffected.

scenario: While walking the perimeter of the lawn, you find a small, intricately woven bamboo flute lying in the grass. It looks like it was dropped recently.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: The group of Chakma youths from the market are seen again at the bottom of the hill near the main gate. They don't look hostile, merely watchful.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: A package arrives for Mr. Irfan. It's a long, narrow box. He quickly takes it inside, looking annoyed that you saw it.

outcomes.flavor: Despite the intrigue, your situation remains unaffected.

scenario: Oli shows you his drone footage. From above, you can see a faint trail leading from the back of the bungalow deep into the jungle, towards a series of caves.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: Nasir bhai points out that for a man worried about a land dispute, Mr. Irfan has surprisingly little security. Just one old caretaker for a large, isolated property.

outcomes.flavor: Despite the intrigue, your situation remains unaffected.

scenario: The generator for the bungalow sputters and dies, plunging the house into silence before the emergency lights kick in. Karim chacha says it's been acting up.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: Fakhruddin finds a strange symbol crudely painted on the back gate. Karim chacha quickly scrubs it off, saying it's just local kids. Too quickly.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: Ahsanul Mama suggests a walk to the local village. He believes a friendly gesture might help ease the tension with the locals.

outcomes.flavor: Despite the intrigue, your situation remains unaffected.

scenario: You see Karim chacha sneaking into the jungle with a small bundle. He returns empty-handed a few minutes later, looking over his shoulder.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: A fierce argument breaks out between Mr. Irfan and someone on his phone. You can't make out the words, but the tone is angry and desperate.

outcomes.flavor: Despite the intrigue, your situation remains unaffected.

scenario: While exploring, you find an old, rusted Tribal Arrowhead half-buried in the soil of the flowerbeds. It looks ancient.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: Oli's drone nearly gets taken out by a large eagle. He lands it just in time, his hands shaking. The jungle protects its own.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: Nasir bhai identifies a rare Hill Flower growing near the bungalow. He says local tribes use it to make a powerful sedative.

outcomes.flavor: Despite the intrigue, your situation remains unaffected.

scenario: The internet connection flickers and dies. The bungalow is now completely cut off from the outside world. Oli is not happy.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: Fakhruddin is convinced he's being followed. He says he keeps seeing the same Chakma youth from the market wherever he goes.

outcomes.flavor: Despite the intrigue, your situation remains unaffected.

scenario: Mr. Irfan announces he has an urgent meeting and leaves in a hurry, telling you all to 'enjoy the peace and quiet'.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: With Mr. Irfan gone, the atmosphere feels different. Less tense, but also more isolated and vulnerable.

outcomes.flavor: Nothing interesting happened.

scenario: A thick evening fog rolls up the valley, swallowing the hills and isolating the bungalow in a sea of white. It's beautiful, but unnerving.

outcomes.flavor: Despite the intrigue, your situation remains unaffected.

scenario: With Mr. Irfan out, Nasir bhai suggests searching his office for clues. The door is unlocked.

outcomes.flavor: You find a diary with coded entries. It'll take time to crack, but it feels important.
You knock over a vase, alerting Karim chacha. You bribe him with one of your items to stay quiet.
Mr. Irfan returns unexpectedly. He is not pleased. He kicks you all out immediately.
You decide it's a bad idea. Snooping could make a tense situation worse.
While you debate, Karim chacha locks the door. He looks at you suspiciously, and later you find your items are gone.

scenario: Oli's drone spotted a small, hidden cave on the cliff face behind the bungalow.

outcomes.flavor: Inside the cave, you find a beautifully woven Chakma Scarf. It's warm and feels calming.
The cave is damp and empty, aside from some very annoyed bats.
The trail is unstable. You slip and fall, ending your adventure with a sprained ankle.
Ahsanul Mama advises caution, saying it's best not to trespass on what might be sacred ground.

scenario: You find a half-drawn map on a coffee table. A single spot on the property is marked with an 'X'.

outcomes.flavor: The 'X' leads to a hollow tree. Inside is a locked box containing a Suspicious Map.
The map leads you into a thorny patch of jungle. You get scratched up and lose an item.
Fakhruddin declares it's a wild goose chase. 'Probably just a doodle.'
Fakhruddin points out the map is a decoy. While you're distracted, someone steals your stuff.

scenario: A Chakma youth cautiously approaches and offers you a small bottle filled with a dark, fragrant liquid.

outcomes.flavor: You accept. Nasir bhai later identifies it as a powerful local Herbal Potion for healing.
You take the bottle but are too suspicious to drink it. It smells vaguely of herbs and mystery.
You politely decline. The youth looks disappointed but not angry, and walks away.
Your refusal is seen as a grave insult. The youth signals his friends, and you are surrounded.

scenario: You find a large, unusual footprint in the mud. Nasir bhai suggests making a plaster cast of it.

outcomes.flavor: You make a clear cast of the print. It's definitely not human or any known local animal.
You try to make a cast, but the mud is too wet and it collapses into a useless lump.
It's probably just a weird mud puddle. You move on.

scenario: Karim chacha tells an old story about a tribal king's treasure hidden on this hill, protected by a powerful curse.

outcomes.flavor: You find a hidden chamber under the bungalow! Inside is a magnificent, jewel-encrusted chest.
You trigger a booby trap while searching. The ground collapses beneath you.
You find the treasure, but the curse is real. A dark spirit emerges and your adventure is over.
You find a fake treasure chest with a spring-loaded trap that snags one of your items.
The real guardians of the treasure find you. They don't kill you, but take everything you own as a warning.
It's a fun story, but you're not about to go chasing myths and curses.

scenario: The generator has failed completely, leaving the bungalow lit only by dim emergency lights.

outcomes.flavor: You fiddle with the engine and miraculously get it working! Everyone hails you as a hero.
You get a nasty shock from a stray wire, dropping and breaking one of your items.
You decide it's too risky to mess with in the dark.
In the darkness, someone sabotages the main door. You're trapped inside with no power.

scenario: You find the long, narrow box delivered to Mr. Irfan, hastily hidden under his bed.

outcomes.flavor: Inside is a high-tech satellite phone. This could be your only link to the outside world.
It's a trap. A hidden needle pricks your finger, and you collapse from a fast-acting poison.
Whatever is in that box is Mr. Irfan's business. You decide not to get involved.

scenario: Ahsanul Mama asks you to accompany him to the Chakma village to speak with their elder.

outcomes.flavor: The elder explains the land was stolen by a rival faction, not Mr. Irfan. He gives you a Secret Key as a sign of trust.
The elder listens patiently but offers no information, saying it is a matter for his people to handle.
While Mama is gone, someone takes advantage of the distraction and steals one of your items.

scenario: Using Fakhruddin's Binoculars, you spot a man on the opposite ridge, watching the bungalow.

outcomes.flavor: You wave. The man immediately packs up his gear and disappears into the jungle.
Oli flies the drone over. Before the man vanishes, the drone gets a clear shot of his face. It's someone you saw talking to Mr. Irfan in town.
The man spots the drone and shoots it out of the sky with a pellet gun. The drone is lost, and you lose an item in the crash.

scenario: You find the Bamboo Flute you saw earlier. It feels strangely warm.

outcomes.flavor: You produce a series of horrible squawks. You are not a musician.
A haunting melody fills the air. A young Chakma girl appears, saying you called her. She offers you a rare Hill Flower.
You pocket the flute. It's a nice memento of this trip.

scenario: The storm has washed out the only road back to town. You are all stranded at the bungalow.

outcomes.flavor: You try for hours, but the landslide is too big. You're not going anywhere without heavy machinery.
You decide to wait. The extra time allows you to find a hidden compartment containing a Lifesaver.
Boredom leads to carelessness. You accidentally break one of your own items.

scenario: Nasir bhai is examining the Tribal Arrowhead you found. He says there's a strange, sticky residue on the tip.

outcomes.flavor: You lick the arrowhead. It's a fast-acting neurotoxin. Why would you do that? Your adventure ends.
You carefully wash the arrowhead. It's a nice, if slightly ominous, souvenir.

scenario: You decode a line from Mr. Irfan's diary: 'The exchange is at midnight. They must not find the real prize.'

outcomes.flavor: You see Mr. Irfan exchanging a briefcase with the men from the ridge. You get a photo of the deal.
You're spotted. The men are not happy to have witnesses. Your adventure ends violently.
Mama listens gravely and tells you all to lock your doors. He says this is far more dangerous than a land dispute.

scenario: Karim chacha offers you a cup of tea with a strange, sweet smell. He seems insistent that you drink it.

outcomes.flavor: The tea is drugged with the sedative from the Hill Flower. You all pass out, and your adventure ends.
It's just really sweet tea. You feel a sugar rush, but nothing else happens.
You say you're not thirsty. Karim chacha looks annoyed but takes the tea away.
He 'accidentally' spills the tea all over your backpack, ruining everything inside.

scenario: You find Fakhruddin's Binoculars left on the veranda.

outcomes.flavor: You scan the hills. It's a beautiful view, but nothing out of the ordinary.
You decide finder's keepers. Fakhruddin will be mad, but these are nice.

scenario: The Secret Key from the elder fits a hidden lock on a statue in the garden.

outcomes.flavor: Inside is the true deed to the land, proving it belongs to the Chakma tribe. This is the evidence you need!
The compartment is empty except for a spring-loaded ink trap that ruins one of your items.
You decide not to use the key without the elder's permission. It's a matter of trust.

scenario: You confront Karim chacha. He breaks down, admitting Mr. Irfan is a smuggler and the 'land dispute' is a cover story.

outcomes.flavor: He agrees to help expose Mr. Irfan and gives you Padlocks to secure a key room.
He pretends to agree, but leads you into a trap set by Mr. Irfan's men.
He begs you not to, saying his family is in danger. He promises to stay out of your way.

scenario: A helicopter is approaching the bungalow. It could be Mr. Irfan's partners, or the authorities.

outcomes.flavor: It's Mr. Irfan's partners. They load several crates and leave. You remain unseen.
It's Mr. Irfan's partners. They see you signalling and are not interested in leaving witnesses.
It's the police! Your satellite phone call worked. The criminals are arrested, and you're rewarded handsomely.

scenario: The final confrontation. Mr. Irfan and his smugglers have you cornered. Ahsanul Mama tries to reason with them.

outcomes.flavor: You knock over a priceless artifact, creating chaos. You all manage to overpower the smugglers.
Your diversion fails. They round you all up and take all of your belongings.
You surrender. They lock you in the cellar, but at least you're safe for the moment.
They have no intention of leaving loose ends. Your decision to surrender was a fatal mistake.

scenario: Oli reveals he hid his drone on the roof and it has been recording everything.

outcomes.flavor: You find a weak internet signal and upload the incriminating footage. The criminals' fates are sealed!

options.action: Use it as a bargaining chip

outcomes.flavor: They laugh and use a signal jammer, rendering the drone useless. They then take all your stuff.

scenario: In the aftermath, the Chakma elder offers you a gift for proving their land claim.

outcomes.flavor: He gives you an incredibly rare and beautiful Hill Flower. A collector would pay a fortune for it.
You tell him their friendship is reward enough. You have made a powerful ally in these hills.

scenario: Nasir bhai has to return to his hospital duties. He praises your bravery before he leaves.

outcomes.flavor: He laughs and hands you a brand new first-aid kit. 'Try not to need this,' he says.
You thank him for his help and wish him a safe journey back.

scenario: The police offer you a share of the reward money for capturing the smugglers.

outcomes.flavor: You accept the reward. Crime fighting pays well!
You ask for the money to be donated to the local Chakma village. You earn their undying respect.

scenario: As you pack up to leave Bandarban, you look back at the 'Meghaloy Bungalow'. It was meant to be a relaxing vacation.

outcomes.flavor: You all share a laugh. It was dangerous, but it was one of the most exciting adventures of your lives.
Fakhruddin declares he's only taking beach vacations from now on. You don't blame him.
